name: Parallel Volume Rendering for Computational Flow Imaging
definition: A parallel volume rendering method for Computational Flow Imaging (CFI) that translates curvilinear multiple overlapping grids CFD resolutions into new rectilinear multi-blocks data fields to eliminate errors caused by intersected or overlapped parts of CFD grids.
summary: Parallel Volume Rendering for Computational Flow Imaging visualizes CFD data by converting curvilinear grids into balanced voxel blocks for efficient parallel ray-casting, avoiding integral errors and unmanageable grid sizes.
